name: Clifton Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St John's Church. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Clifton Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Broadhollow Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
